english.title: Manufacturer fail to inform market surveillance authority of risk presented by non-conforming category F1/F2/F3 firework
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a manufacturer who considered or had reason to believe that a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework, which you had placed on the market was not in conformity with Part 2 of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 and that firework presented a risk, failed to immediately inform the market surveillance authority of the risk, giving details of the respect in which it was considered not to be in conformity with Part 2 and any corrective measures taken
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 22(2), 62(1)(k) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
